name: the-fraud
description: The Fraud - realtime multiplayer deduction game (Express + Socket.IO + React)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix client run lint && npm --prefix server run lint
